solr_urls.description: One or more Solr server URLs for indexing and querying mail content.

solr_username.description: Username for HTTP Basic Auth to Solr (leave blank if unauthenticated).

solr_password.description: Password for HTTP Basic Auth to Solr (leave blank if unauthenticated).

solr_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for Solr HTTP requests. Increase for slow networks or large indexes.

solr_batch_size.description: Number of messages to batch per indexing request. Larger batches improve throughput but use more memory.

solr_autoindex.description: Whether to automatically index new or modified messages upon delivery or change.

solr_retries.description: Number of retry attempts for transient failures during indexing.

solr_doc_prefix.description: Prefix prepended to Solr document IDs to avoid naming collisions across services.

solr_core.description: Solr core (or collection) name used for storing mail FTS data.

solr_ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS when connecting to Solr over HTTPS.

solr_ssl_verify.description: Verify Solr SSL certificate when HTTPS is enabled.

solr_ssl_cert_path.description: Path to client certificate (PEM format) for mTLS (optional).

solr_ssl_key_path.description: Path to client private key (PEM format) for mTLS (optional).

solr_ssl_ca_cert_path.description: Path to CA certificate (PEM format) for validating Solr's server certificate.
